calculated_totals_inr.notes: Year 1 inflated by signing and relocation bonuses. Exhaustion of one-time bonuses causes compensation to taper from ~85.5L to ~53.4L by year 4.

specific_compensation_data.key_insight: Media sensationalizes highest CTC numbers without contextualizing the underlying financial architecture. The gap between headline CTC and actual liquid base salary is massive due to equity vesting and one-time bonuses.
